votes.motion: Approve the work session and formal meeting minutes of January 3, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session and formal meeting minutes from January 3, 2023.

votes.motion: Approve the revised, Joint Resolution 02 of 2023, recognizing February as Black History Month
votes.description: The Council approved a corrected version of the joint ceremonial resolution with the Mayor recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City, fixing previous omissions.

votes.motion: Having voted on the prevailing side, propose a recall to the motion from February 14, 2023 due to a necessary revision
votes.description: The Council voted to recall the prior motion approving the Black History Month resolution from February 14, 2023 in order to allow the revised resolution to stand in its place.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 03 of 2023 Urban Forest Action Plan
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance formalizing the Urban Forest Action Plan, which provides guidance and steps for aligning City resources with sustainability and equity goals related to trees on public and private lands.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the $3.5 Million HOME-ARPA Grant Funding item to a future date for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the $3.5 million HOME-ARPA grant funding resolution and deferred action to a future meeting date.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and support the land exchange to facilitate the Bridge to Backman Project
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and approved the land exchange transferring open space at 592 N. Riverside Drive to Riverwood Cove, LLC in exchange for an equal-sized parcel, facilitating a new park and school connection near Backman Elementary.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 04 of 2023 Rezone at approximately 130 North 2100 West
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance removing the AFPP Overlay District Influence Zone B from a property at 130 N. 2100 West to allow its use as permanent supportive housing primarily for those 62 and older.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 05 of 2023 Local Link Study Update to 2023 Sugar House Circulation Plan
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance incorporating the Local Link Study as an official update to the 2013 Sugar House Circulation Plan, including transit and transportation recommendations for the Sugar House area.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 06 of 2023 Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 704 East 900 South, with conditions through a development agreement (retain existing structure for 50 years, maintain at least four dwelling units, no short-term rentals under 30 days)
votes.description: The Council approved rezoning 704 E. 900 South from R-2 to SNB with development agreement conditions to preserve the structure and dwelling units and prohibit short-term rentals, despite a negative Planning Commission recommendation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 07 of 2023 Rocky Mountain Power Rezone
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning property at 1223 West North Temple and portions of adjacent properties to TSA-Urban Center-Core to accommodate Rocky Mountain Power's new office headquarters.

votes.motion: Approve and adopt items F1 Ordinance 08 of 2023 Public Accommodation Closed Captioning; F2 Resolution 03 of 2023 and Resolution 04 of 2023 Approving Amendments to UPACA Interlocal Agreements; F3 Ordinance 09 of 2023 Amending the Parks, Natural Lands, Trails, and Urban Forestry Advisory Board; and F4 Ordinance 10 of 2023 Amending the Salt Lake City Sister Cities Board
votes.description: The Council approved a block of four unfinished business items including a closed captioning ordinance, two UPACA interlocal agreement amendments, an amendment adding Indigenous Tribe representatives to the PNUT Board, and an amendment to the Sister Cities Board code.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for Budget Amendment No. 5, the Northpoint Small Area Plan, and the Glendale Regional Park Plan, as well as board appointments for Jeff Driggs and Matthew Coles to the Arts Council and Justice Morath to the Transportation Advisory Board.
